test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Seven people, B, N, M, O, P, Y and S are sitting in a straight line, facing south. Only two people sit between P and S. N is the immediate neighbour of S and M. Only one person sits to the right of P. N sits second to the left of O. Y is an immediate neighbour of P.

Total how many people sit between P and M?
solution:
**Given :** Seven people, B, N, M, O, P, Y and S are sitting in a straight line, facing south. 

**Explanation :**

1) Only one person sits to the right of P.

2) Only two people sit between P and S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6802fcec51bd1db6149ec11a4ad8acf606492a17290fdd073d72b754f3eab52.png] 

3) N is the immediate neighbour of S and M.

4) N sits second to the left of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c68606cab42faaf505fc3949ecb6edb4cf78e566411d9c9398bae52d670504d8.png] 

5) Y is an immediate neighbour of P.

As position of Y with respect to P is not known yet therefore there are two possible positions for Y.

After positioning Y only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f09d5c46dcd0ee2c0a11d68d0b128383783e30e36b5014cf6678c0bd4a5bd97.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement four people i.e O, S, N and M sit between P and M.

Hence, **"Four"** is the correct answer.
